01_repository_summary.title: Repository Summary
01_repository_summary.what_repository_does: Terraform module for a MongoDB Atlas project and its cluster. Published to S3 as atlas-cluster-<version.zip and consumed by pinning that object. One call creates a project and exactly one replica set in it, plus the pieces a tenant needs to reach and operate the cluster: | Project | the project, its team assignments, IP access list, maintenance window and auditing | | Cluster | one mongodbatlasadvancedcluster replica set, backup on, autoscaling between instancesizemin and instancesizemax | | Users | admin and monitor, plus anything in additionalusers, each with a generated password | | Optional | the Atlas Prometheus integration and its Kubernetes ScrapeConfig, off unless prometheusintegration = true | Outputs are connectionstrings, projectid, the user names, their passwords (sensitive) and prometheususername. | Scrape Atlas metrics into Prometheus | prometheusintegration = true | | Put the ScrapeConfig in another namespace | prometheusnamespace | | Name the cluster differently from the project | clustername |
